attributes.name: Sho Habby Scans
attributes.description:
## "So called scan group"
We're a small scanlation group dedicated to delivering high quality scans with fully redrawn SFX (within reason). We hope you like our work! We're open to picking up more series given we can find staff to provide consistent uploads for them. Come hang out with us in our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/GdV76sQs7d)!

Current series (in pickup order):
- [Josee to Tora to Sakana-tachi (Josee, the Tiger and the Fish)](https://mangadex.org/title/c8c7de84-4ad7-4712-9800-549314c8e6c6)
- [Kaette Kudasai, Akutsu-san! (Please Go Home, Akutsu-san!)](https://mangadex.org/title/737a846b-2e67-4d63-9f7e-f54b3beebac4)
- [Kono Kaisha ni Suki na Hito ga Imasu (I Have a Crush at Work)](https://mangadex.org/title/3e8cf40f-ba17-480a-b60b-a675db032ee2)
- [Horimiya](https://mangadex.org/title/a25e46ec-30f7-4db6-89df-cacbc1d9a900) (Vol. 17 w/ [iltrof](https://mangadex.org/group/aaa9c59b-dec8-4c65-bfd8-27fe6ff7402d) & [TSP](https://mangadex.org/group/4d41149e-0ec8-4846-82a2-88d112b9dffa))
- [Shinimodori Reijou no Lucetta](https://mangadex.org/title/8546848b-0c69-4e1f-b6b5-4b0b3bf0cb3d) (w/ [Shared Reads](https://mangadex.org/group/9f9f4d80-8a58-41cb-8bb3-a13426642ba5))
- [Busu ni Hanataba wo. (April Showers Bring May Flowers)](https://mangadex.org/title/b8272d78-498e-477c-8835-548d3f2370e4)
- [Yancha Gal no Anjou-san](https://mangadex.org/title/5e3a710f-0b0d-482b-9e84-d9c91960c625)
- [Seishun Buta Yarou wa Siscon Idol wo Yume no Minai (Rascal Does Not Dream of a Siscon Idol)](https://mangadex.org/title/8587c766-37a3-4fb0-89db-8145fafb3152)
- [Ogami Tsumiki to Kinichijou (Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life)](https://mangadex.org/title/df361a38-eef6-4674-bec6-86d08aa1d1aa) (Ch. 1-8 w/ [Emergency Tsumiki Comittee](https://mangadex.org/group/e62b19b7-e4a2-4119-a7c3-31b1c278ea59) & [Church of Potteto](https://mangadex.org/group/457ff7be-62ab-4552-83d8-ee3f3e1c02c1))
- [Sasayaku you ni Koi wo Utau (Whisper Me a Love Song)](https://mangadex.org/title/0e8fac17-979e-4e37-8f45-2c334b25d6dd) (SFX Only)
- [Anemone wa Netsu wo Obiru (The Anemone Feels The Heat)](https://mangadex.org/title/c5d731f9-c1cf-4a69-a797-cd9c2a58316b)
- [Houkago, Bokura wa Uchuu ni Madou](https://mangadex.org/title/91a2e0c9-cd81-4bf7-b5f7-bb37434bf6b3)

Other stuff we have worked on:
- [Kubo-san wa Boku (Mobu) wo Yurusanai (Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible)](https://mangadex.org/title/cddd1849-ab36-4304-8103-06ba4062b5e6) (extras)

- [Hanamaru Hoppe](https://mangadex.org/title/68b5d925-acf0-48d5-a051-c84446ce0d23)
- [Alice-san Chi no Iroribata](https://mangadex.org/title/0df86784-961a-443c-9765-8b41702c6249) (completed)
- [Sukinako ga Megane wo Wasureta (The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses) — Twitter Extras](https://mangadex.org/title/43541d36-7996-472b-aefb-72f640c29eda)
- [Hana ni Arashi (Rainbows After Storms)](https://mangadex.org/title/bc86a871-ddc5-4e42-812a-ccd38101d82e) (completed)

### We're not sorry, we've learned nothing, we'll do it again.
